I'm impressed. They have complete equipment to tame our feral cat. LOL. The owner stood by and watched. I brought the cat to see me with a sore eye and had its nails trimmed. It was more expensive than the government hospital I'd taken my cat to before, only about 200-300 baht. But the service was very different. I also got a vaccination for distemper, feline flu, and leukemia, which was about 2×××฿. It's not incredibly expensive. Compared to the service of the doctor and assistants, I'm impressed.

The clinic has a very welcoming atmosphere. The staff and doctor are calm, attentive, and provide helpful advice. It's a two-shophouse building, quite narrow, but there's enough seating.
There's parking available in front of the clinic, but if it's full, you can park in the 7-Eleven lot across the street for 30 baht per hour.

I took my youngest Chihuahua to the vet on New Year's Day, December 31st and January 1st, for two consecutive days. The vet took good care of him, and all the staff loved animals. The prices were reasonable, and they were very hardworking. Thank you so much, vet!

text: Animal clinic with good service. The doctor gives excellent advice. There is an X-ray machine, blood test, urine test, results are available, flea and tick drops, deworming, complete service, reasonable price.
My daughter had her spaying and vaccinations done here two years ago. The doctor is kind, and the staff are very patient. We are very impressed.

The doctor and assistants are kind to the animals and explain the symptoms and treatment procedures very well. There is not a long wait for both treatment and payment. During busy times, it can be a bit crowded because the waiting area is small, but it doesn't seem to be a problem. Regarding the treatment cost, if compared to another place I've been to, it's a new clinic with branches, modern, and the prices are similar. The clinic calls to remind you of an appointment 1 day in advance every time.
The doctor was lovely and took very good care of our children.

The new team of doctors are friendly and provide good service. The service fee might be a bit higher than when the doctor was still here, but that's understandable. However, I'd like the clinic to accept credit cards because if the cost is high, it might help the owner breathe a little easier. The minimum is 1,000 baht (please consider this).

The treatment was good. At first, I went to a clinic and they told me to come here for an X-ray. But here, they didn't need an X-ray at all. They examined my body and immediately knew what was wrong with my cat and treated me at a reasonable price. Now my cat is running around, fat, and comfortable at home. The staff provided good service as well.

The vet is very kind and answers all questions. She explains everything in detail. The assistants are also very kind. We always bring our cat here for vaccinations and when she's sick. It might be a bit crowded on Saturdays and Sundays, but you can usually wait in line. The clinic has expanded to two rooms, so there's more waiting space now.

I brought my Shih Tzu to the vet, and the treatment costs here are very affordable. She's quite old, and due to her existing health conditions, I was worried the treatment would be very expensive, like at other places I've been to, …
The doctor was very kind. The space is a bit cramped, but there's a place to sit and wait. The queue moved quickly. I heard they're not offering grooming services at the moment.

I took my hamster to get treatment. The doctor was kind, friendly, and polite. He was very gentle when giving the injections. My hamster didn't cry at all. Plus, the price was not expensive. I highly recommend this place.

I have to say, not every veterinary clinic provides treatment of this high standard. I've personally tried many veterinary clinics, both in other areas and nearby, but I've never found one that impressed me as much as this one. The price is reasonable, the service is excellent, and they are attentive.
I have to say, for veterinary clinics in this area, this is the best.
Both in terms of price and the care they give to the animals.

The doctor and nurses are kind and very friendly to my little one. This is the first place where my little one has gotten an injection and not cried or been afraid. The treatment fee is not expensive. In the evening, there are a lot of people. You have to park at the 7-11 across the street.

I called to inquire about preparing my cat for sterilization. The employee who answered the phone was very harsh and rude. It's good that the clinic was closed today and that I didn't use their services.

The shop is open from afternoon to evening.
The veterinarians and nurses provide excellent advice on pet care.
I've taken my cat there for treatment several times before. The prices are reasonable. They also sell pet food, toys, and other pet supplies.
Overnight pet boarding is available.

They provide excellent care for dogs and cats. They have all the necessary equipment, including X-rays and blood tests with immediate results. The prices are reasonable, and both the vet and assistants are very kind.

At the beginning of September, my dog ​​had a very serious head tilt disease, so I thought of this clinic to get treatment before it started to tilt its head. But it was too late, so I had to go to the Small Animal Hospital at Chula …

This clinic is incredibly clean. On my first visit, I was surprised by how practically you didn't need to wear shoes inside. I was about to take my shoes off, but the staff told me to keep them on. The service was excellent, the medication was fantastic, and it wasn't expensive. I highly recommend it; you won't be disappointed.

I took my cat to the vet, and they took a blood sample for testing. The cat had a seizure and died while I was there. I only got the diagnosis 7 hours after the cat died. Thank you so much; this information is incredibly helpful.

The doctor and nurses are lovely and friendly.
The doctor doesn't focus on selling, but rather on educating owners.
They are very kind to the dogs and cats.

The vet is highly recommended. Don't be disgusted or repulsed when your dog is sick. Both the vet and the assistant are incredibly kind. They read and reply to all messages. They are the best vet I've ever met!
